dct_description_sm: The immediate objective is to provide a preliminary estimate of dietary exposure to a suite of emerging contaminants of potential concern - perfluorinated acids (PFAs) - for consumers of traditional foods.  A longer term objective is to evaluate the relative contribution of traditional and market food consumption to PFA dietary exposure.

dct_title_s: Estimation of dietary exposure to perfluorinated carboxylates and sulfonates via consumption of traditional foods
